final: {"prompt": "A square, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting in oil and cold wax on heavy canvas. The paint fills the entire square edge to edge, with no frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting. The palette is deep ultramarine, blue-black, and bruised violet. A narrow band of burnt vermilion and one hot streak of cadmium orange run through it. Pale chalk white, raw linen, and a muted ochre provide quiet relief. The left two-thirds is dense and turbulent. Dozens of translucent glazes are stacked and scraped back, so buried layers of teal, plum, and rust show through torn openings. Short, fast, overlapping palette-knife strokes and dry-brush drags pull in many directions at once. They gradually align into one strong diagonal sweep of thick, loaded impasto that cuts toward the upper right. The sweep is the sharpest, most decisive gesture in the painting. Around it the texture is gritty and ridged, with dripped and wiped veils, sanded patches, and fine scratched lines through wet paint. Toward the right and lower right the density thins into a large open area of soft, nearly empty chalky white and pale grey-blue. It is lightly veiled and quiet, with only faint ghost traces of earlier strokes under the surface. A few small, deliberate touches of warm color float in this space. The tension comes from the push between crowded, competing marks and the clear, calm opening. The rhythm moves from clamor to clarity, with visible brushwork, thick and thin paint, matte and glossy passages, and strong value contrast. Lighting is flat and even, like a close-up photograph of the painted surface. There are no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
